name: Replication Data for: Population dynamics of Manyara monkey Cercopithecus mitis manyaraensis and vervet monkey Chlorocebus pygerythrus in Lake Manyara National Park, Tanzania
description: This dataset contains population densities and observed group sizes of primate species in Lake Manyara National Park, Tanzania. The first and second datasheets contain point estimates ("Density") and associated 95% confidence intervals ("lower"; "upper") of Manyara monkeys and vervet monkey. Densities were estimated for each season (LR=Long rains; Dry = Dry season; SR= Short rains) in the years 2011 to 2019. The group size datasheet contains data on the observed group sizes of each target species during the seasonal surveys.
keywords: population dynamics; distance sampling; time series; primates
